findings.name: XiaoiceSing
findings.claim: Residual log-F0 around MIDI notes won 97.3% A/B vs independent LSTM F0 (RMSE 10.45 vs 13.74 Hz).
findings.design_implication: F0 is a residual around the score, not a text-predicted contour.

findings.name: Sinsy
findings.claim: Time-lag model: consonants start before notated onset; vowel onset tracks the beat; without pitch-norm F0-RMSE jumps ~74 to 264 cents.
findings.design_implication: Anticipatory coarticulation is a time-lag around the score, not ToBI.

findings.name: NNSVS
findings.claim: Joint DNNs overweight spectrum vs F0; DiffSinger retrain produced discontinuous F0 and unstable vibrato.
findings.design_implication: Keep F0 as its own residual stream.

findings.name: ExpressiveSinger
findings.claim: High MOS still lacks musicality without explicit performance control of onset deviations, F0 curves, and amplitude envelopes from score+style.
findings.design_implication: MIDI is the skeleton; performance is predicted around it.

findings.name: TechSinger
findings.claim: L1/FFT F0 cannot capture technique-dependent contours; a pitch predictor conditioned on notes+lyrics+technique beats DiffSinger/VISinger 2 on FFE.
findings.design_implication: Speech variance-adaptor F0 is the wrong family.

findings.name: UniVoice
findings.claim: Naïve shared melody conditioning causes gradient conflict (speech PER 12.31%/singing 23.45% vs 5.26%/16.22% with factorization).
findings.design_implication: Do not reuse speech-TTS prosody as singing melody.
findings.authors: Zheng, Xue, Ren, Ding, Liu & Chen

findings.name: NHSS: A Speech and Singing Parallel Database
findings.claim: Sung English vowels average 830.5 ms vs 148.0 ms spoken (~5.6×); sung F0 histograms show discrete note peaks speech lacks.
findings.design_implication: Speech-TTS duration/F0 cannot be copied onto lyrics.

findings.name: Acoustic Theory of Speech Production
findings.claim: The radiated voice is source × tract filter; independence is only a first approximation.
findings.design_implication: A formant-shaped oscillator that never generates a glottal flow and then filters it is not a voice.

findings.name: Chest/mix/head classification from mel texture around passaggio
findings.claim: Classifies chest/mix/head-mix/head from mel-spectrogram texture around male passaggio; mixed voice is TA–CT balance, not a single F0 label.
findings.design_implication: Measurement/pedagogy naming ≠ SVS register enum. Do not invent register enums.

findings.name: nnsvs.gen class reference
findings.claim: Score-locked path predicts/post-processes mgc, lf0, vuv, bap; relative_f0 ties LF0 to MIDI score pitch; vibrato_scale and phone V/UV flags exist — source-filter streams, not named formant/register knobs.
findings.design_implication: Opaque streams under score lock.

findings.name: vocal-synth-engine README
findings.claim: Additive + spectral envelope + noise; cockpit/API exposes per-note breathiness, timbre, vibrato, portamento and XY timbre×breathiness — no documented singer-formant or falsetto/register field on VocalScore.
findings.design_implication: Generators/cockpit off register ACCEPT knobs.

findings.name: ACE-Step 1.5 Inference API
findings.claim: GenerationParams metadata is caption/lyrics + bpm / keyscale / timesignature / duration — no note MIDI, no register, no formant; song-generator surface opposite the SVS craft axis.
findings.design_implication: Song-gen surface opposite score-lock.

findings.name: A four-parameter model of glottal flow
findings.claim: The LF source is the derivative of glottal flow (Ee closing discontinuity + Ta return phase), not a harmonic oscillator.
findings.design_implication: Pitch-shifting a looped aah or Kokoro formant preset without open-quotient/return-phase/Ee cannot produce modal vs breathy vs pressed source spectra.

findings.name: Vocal Music under Phoneme-Conditional Analysis
findings.claim: Isolates phoneme-conditional F1–F3, spectral tilt, H1–H2/HNR; analysis dimensions, not controllable register knobs.
findings.design_implication: F1–F3/tilt analysis ≠ register API.

findings.name: Modeling source-filter interaction in belting and high-pitched operatic male singing
findings.claim: Source–filter interaction in belt vs classical; 2F0/F1–F2 inertance and register flip risk — pedagogy/physics floor under mix/passaggio.
findings.design_implication: Belt/opera source-filter floor.

findings.name: SiFiSinger: A High-Fidelity End-to-End Singing Voice Synthesizer based on Source-filter Model
findings.claim: Neural source–filter SVS with F0-driven harmonics and mcep envelope; control is F0+envelope, not isFalsetto/singer-formant params.
findings.design_implication: F0/envelope surface; no register enums.
findings.authors: Cui, Gu, Weng, Zhang, Chen et al.

findings.name: Controllable Singing Voice Synthesis using Phoneme-Level Energy Sequence
findings.claim: Phoneme-level energy/dynamics control without register or singer-formant dimensions.
findings.design_implication: Energy control ≠ register enum.

findings.name: DiffSinger Best Practices
findings.claim: Acoustic inputs are fixed to phoneme seq + phoneme duration + F0; narrow variance knobs are energy, breathiness, voicing, tension — no named register or singer-formant control.
findings.design_implication: Do not invent register enums on DiffSinger.

findings.name: Bi-stable vocal fold adduction
findings.claim: Registers are glottal shapes, not F0 labels (modal / falsetto / fry).
findings.design_implication: One LF/waveguide source with only F0 changed cannot be SATB modal vs falsetto.

findings.name: Flexible Singing Voice Synthesis Through Decomposed Framework with Inferrable Features
findings.claim: Decomposed score-to-waveform feature streams; flexibility ≠ pedagogy register enums.
findings.design_implication: Feature decomposition; no register enums.

findings.name: OpenUtau default expressions (USTx.cs)
findings.claim: Editor surface maps gender/g (−100…100, formant shift), breath/B, breathiness curve, tension curve, voicing curve — production path for DiffSinger/resampler timbre, still not a register enum.
findings.design_implication: Breathiness/tension/gender on hard F0; no register enum.

findings.name: Cantor Digitalis (Web Audio) README
findings.claim: Perceptual API exposes isFalsetto (M1/M2), tenseness, breathiness, vocalTractSize, and synth-level F1–F6 formant centers — register is an explicit boolean, not an F0 label.
findings.design_implication: Only parametric surfaces expose isFalsetto + formants.

findings.name: LAPS-Diff: Diffusion-Based SVS With Language Aware Prosody-Style Guided Learning
findings.claim: Prosody/style guidance ≠ mixed-voice/passaggio registration or singer-formant tract settings.
findings.design_implication: Style/prosody ≠ register enum.

findings.name: Cantor Digitalis tech notes
findings.claim: Docs state the singing formant is produced by grouping F3–F5, with hypo-pharynx anti-resonance ~2.5–3.5 kHz — formant cluster is a tract setting, not painted EQ.
findings.design_implication: Singer formant is tract setting (F3–F5 cluster).

findings.name: WORLD README
findings.claim: Public API is F0 + spectral envelope (CheapTrick) + aperiodicity (D4C) → synthesize; no register or singer-formant parameter names — envelope is opaque.
findings.design_implication: mgc/BAP/LF0 ≠ formant/register APIs.
